id: \bYou want some extra power in your battle against Bea? Use this.
en: \bYou want some extra power in your battle against Bea? Use this.
it: \bVuoi una marcia in più nella lotta contro Fabia? Usa questo.

id: \bIt will evolve some Dark-types. You'll need it against her Fighting-types.
en: \bIt will evolve some Dark-types. You'll need it against her Fighting-types.
it: \bFa evolvere alcuni Pokémon di tipo Buio. Ti serviranno contro i suoi tipi Lotta.

id: \rFighting-types are superior. They can punch really hard.
en: \rFighting-types are superior. They can punch really hard.
it: \rI tipi Lotta sono superiori. Sanno tirare pugni fortissimi.

id: \bGhost-types are superior. They can ignore hard punches.
en: \bGhost-types are superior. They can ignore hard punches.
it: \bI tipi Spettro sono superiori. Possono ignorare i pugni fortissimi.

id: \rPeople don't pay attention to Allister. I think he prefers it that way.
en: \rPeople don't pay attention to Allister. I think he prefers it that way.
it: \rLa gente non fa caso a Onion. Credo che lui preferisca così.
